signal: Tricerat named a new CEO and launched ScrewDrivers 7.8 with ARM64 support and granular secure-printing permissions, positioning ahead of Microsoft's July 2026 print driver change.

email.body1:
Jon, saw Tricerat brought on a new CEO and shipped ScrewDrivers 7.8 ahead of Microsoft's July 2026 print driver change.

A regulatory shift like that usually surfaces more accounts that need to migrate than the team can reach in time, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Tricerat off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jon, quick follow-up for Tricerat.

The July 2026 Microsoft change is a timed window, and the demand will outpace what the team can reach manually. Most BD leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the window closes.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tricerat needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jon, last bit of proof for Tricerat.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tricerat's reply rate likely compares to peer IT-infrastructure teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jon, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a leadership transition keeps a BD calendar packed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Tricerat's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
